name: Incl
ability: Liquid Ooze / Sticky Hold / Clear Body (hidden)
look: a small glossy blob of ink with glowing yellow eyes and a silver calligraphy pen nib for a face
entry: A drop of ink that came to life on the page of an old letter. The silver pen nib it wears as a face is sharp, and it scribbles angry lines on anything that bothers it.
how: Wild: rare at night in villages, and in deep-dark and dripstone caves.
